name: y-lang
description: Language server for the Y programming language (ycc): diagnostics, semantic highlighting, formatting

y.lsp.serverPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `yserve` binary. Leave empty to search next to the extension, then the workspace root, then `$PATH`.

y.lsp.rootPath.markdownDescription: Workspace root passed to `yserve` as `--root`. Imports in an open file resolve against the file's own directory first, so this only matters for files outside the workspace. Empty uses the server's working directory.

y.lsp.checkOnChange.markdownDescription: Run the checker and the linter on every keystroke. Off checks on `didOpen` and `didSave` only, which is much cheaper on a large file and costs you live errors. **The other features are unaffected**: hover, completion, semantic tokens and formatting still read your unsaved buffer, so they are never a keystroke behind.

y.lsp.trace.server.description: Log the JSON-RPC traffic between VS Code and yserve to the Y output channel.
